_help: The onboarder (/setup) writes profile/settings.json from your answers. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every tool reads this file; nothing personal is written in the code. Check it with: python3 -I tools/crew.py --check
_coop: number: 1st, 2nd or 3rd co-op. cycle: spring or fall. start/end: YYYY-MM-DD. availability: the exact sentence every email and form uses for dates. recruitment_term: true while you are in your NUworks recruitment term.
_mode: nuworks+external, external, or self-developed. self-developed turns on the banned-list check (profile/banned-employers.md) and keeps NUworks employers out.
_work_auth: One entry per country you target. sentence is used word for word in forms and (with include_in_email) emails. visa_type and never_visa_types drive the form answer gate (for example F-1 CPT, never H-1B).
_targets: title_regex and exclude_regex are case-insensitive regular expressions on job titles. pay_floor_hourly in USD.
_limits: Defaults: 5 applications and 10 emails a day. Emails have a hard maximum of 40 a day whatever is written here.
_regions: Every email names one region: its time zone, the recipient-local send window, and its country (for the work-authorization sentence).

send._mode: prepare = approved emails are saved as drafts you send yourself (default). send = approved emails are sent (macOS Mail only).

_mail: adapter: auto (Mail on a Mac with an account, else .eml drafts), mac-mail, or eml. account: the name Mail shows under Settings > Accounts.

writing.opt_out_line: If this isn't relevant, just let me know and I won't follow up.

_nuworks: Off until the co-op office's written OK (mcp/nuworks/APPROVAL.md) and your own choice in /setup.
